notes: 3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on food and 3 on gold ASAP. @unit_hre/prelate.png@ inspiring all
First new @unit_worker/villager.png@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ then @resource/rally.png@@resource/sheep.png@.
Once you have 8 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on  @resource/resource_food.png@, @resource/rally.png@ @resource/resource_wood.png@.
@age/age_2.webp@@landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.png@ with 4 @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ and rally them back to @resource/resource_food.png@ after.
Move 1 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@. Get the straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@ around our @building_economy/town-center.png@ first.
Have 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.png@ build an @building_defensive/outpost.png@ ASAP.
@unit_hre/prelate.webp@ goes inside @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.png@ as age up is finished.
4 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ will go straight to @resource/resource_stone.png@ without mining camp.
2 @unit_worker/villager.png@go to gold and 2@unit_worker/villager.png@ to food after getting stone.
Build 2nd @building_defensive/outpost.webp@.
Get @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.png@ for your towers.
These are the numbers we are trying to end @age/age_2.webp@ with.

@age/age_3.webp@@landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.png@ with 8 @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@.  Then @building_economy/town-center.png@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@.
It is now that we will start getting our economy upgrades. start with @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@ & @technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@.
START GETTING RELICS@resource/relics.webp@and @resource/sacred_sites.png@ as well if you can.

Keep @building_economy/town-center.png@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@.Start looking to get @technology_economy/forestry.png@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@. If you can not leave your base to secure more food start looking to transition into @building_economy/farm.png@. Otherwise, think about getting more @resource/deer.png@ or even @resource/boar.png@ on the map.  Make a @building_economy/market.png@ the first chance you get.
Spam @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ OR @unit_cavalry/knight-2.png@.

Assuming you have at least 3 @resource/relics.webp@ and militery units, these numbers are possible to age up with. But its still a good idea to have some @resource/resource_gold.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@.
Get any unit upgrade as needed and your remaining economy upgrades.
Try to get to @age/age_4.png@ before 16:00 minutes if possible and good luck!
